correctness.rationale: The proof gives an exact frequency-block characterization of conditional negative type, a cycle second-difference calculation with strict negative spectral margin at p=1, uniform-in-frequency expansion at p=1+t/n², and high-frequency control by continuous trigonometric approximation. The odd fixed modes remain strictly negative; fixed even modes have the unique earliest limiting crossing at frequency 2 because A_2>A_4>.... This proves the upper and lower asymptotic bounds for all sufficiently large odd orders. Independent finite computations cross-check 5,337 assertions, without being used to infer the infinite result.

value.rationale: The supremal negative-type exponent is the canonical sharp Hilbert snowflake threshold for a natural unicyclic graph family. An exact inverse-square convergence rate, its nontrivial cosine-integral constant, and its mode-two instability mechanism provide a genuinely new structural and asymptotic classification rather than a routine finite computation or parameter re-labelling.
